name: feedback-memory
description: Remembers why you approved, edited or rejected Claude's drafts. Your standing rules load at session start, the closest past corrections are added to each prompt, and MCP tools record new decisions.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Leave empty to match by shared words, offline. With a key, recall_corrections matches by meaning (text-embedding-3-small).
